text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What? I'm hungry, so I'm eating. Duh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing you want me to eat a "real
meal" or
whatever, but supplements and
cereal just get the
job done more
efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as I get my nutrients, it doesn't
matter
what I eat. I mean, if it tastes
good then cool, but
that's not what
matters most to—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Forget it. I yapped too much... Tch.
